visual_logic.subject_appearance: Solid black silhouette of a robust, deep-bodied marine crocodile known as 'Godzilla of the Sea'.
visual_logic.environment: High-contrast 'Silvery-White' water surface reflecting a tropical sunset.
visual_logic.backlight_strategy: DUSK_SILHOUETTE to emphasize the unusually short, deep skull.
visual_logic.facial_silhouette: A blunt, high-crested snout with large, visible serrated teeth in the silhouette profile; much deeper than a standard crocodile.

pose: Side profile in a powerful lunge, highlighting the absence of osteoderms (smooth back) and the distinct tail fluke.
negative_constraints: No internal scales; the silhouette must emphasize the 'blunt' rather than 'pointy' face.
